comparison.objective: Start and back off a tap using a two-handled tap wrench.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply balanced bimanual torque to one wrench while limiting lateral load.
comparison.success_condition: Tap advances a quarter turn, backs off a tenth turn, and remains unbroken.
comparison.reason: This close torque neighbor tests symmetric wrench turning and chip breaking, not driver counterholding during locknut tightening or subsequent setting retention.
